data.title: Trump Rejects ‘Globalist Regulation’ of AI, Warns US Won’t ‘Allow’ Others to Stifle It: SI Is ‘Almost Completely Good’ But Has ‘Bad Elements’
data.description: Trump rejects global AI regulation at APEC, saying the U.S. will protect its superintelligence lead while cautioning about risks.

data.title: Immutep Reports 81.1% Disease-Free Survival Rate in Soft Tissue Sarcoma Trial
data.description: Immutep posts an 81.1% 12-month disease-free survival rate in its Phase 2 soft tissue sarcoma study and plans a new trial in 2027.

data.title: Palo Alto Networks Stock Soars: Investors Cheer Strong Outlook, Applied Compute Acquisition
data.description: Palo Alto Networks beats fiscal 2027 first-quarter guidance as revenue jumps 39%, NGS ARR climbs 66%, and adjusted free cash flow reaches $1.9 billion.

data.title: Jim Cramer: Rocket Lab Is 'Too Cheap,' Recommends Buying This Tech Stock
data.description: Jim Cramer recommended Qnity, Rocket Lab, Arm and Akamai, favoring Corning over Amphenol for fiber optics, citing earnings and growth.

data.title: Medicus Pharma Secures Conditional Nasdaq Listing Compliance After Equity Financings
data.description: Medicus Pharma (NASDAQ: MDCX) regained Nasdaq listing compliance after raising $4.25 million in equity and exchanging $10.5 million in debt.
